description: The tent format disappears in favour of feature-length adventures, taking Jeremy, Richard and James by boat, sports car, rally car and questionable machinery across Asia, Africa, Europe and finally Zimbabwe.

s04e01.description: The trio abandon cars for boats and travel from Cambodia through Tonlé Sap and the Mekong Delta toward Vietnam, discovering that water does not make them more competent travellers.

s04e02.description: Sports cars on Réunion lead to Madagascar and one of the world's roughest roads as Jeremy, Richard and James chase a supposed treasure across terrain completely unsuited to their machinery.

s04e03.description: Confined to Britain during the pandemic, the trio take three enormous 1970s American cars through Scotland to discover why such machines never caught on in the UK.

s04e04.description: Jeremy, Richard and James investigate French car culture with eccentric engineering, mountain driving, absurd stunts and a medieval finale on the English Channel.

s04e05.description: Three favourite rally-bred cars cross the Scandinavian Arctic Circle through frozen lakes, Cold War facilities, ski resorts and repeated mechanical and human mishaps.

s04e06.description: The trio drive bizarre cars from Gdańsk through Slovakia, Hungary and Slovenia, encountering improvised motorsport, archery, a racing driver and an increasingly theatrical journey south.

s04e07.description: Following the spirit of the Paris-Dakar rally through Mauritania, the trio use cheap modified sports cars to cross desert, railway and river obstacles while trying not to lose their fuel.

s04e08.description: For their final journey together, Jeremy, Richard and James choose cars they have always wanted and cross Zimbabwe toward a familiar destination, closing the original Grand Tour era.
